title: Assemble context and resolve overflow
steps: Mention exact sources (files, selections, diagnostics, terminal excerpts, diffs, URLs, prior chats).
Inspect URI, range, version, byte size and inclusion reason for each source.
Attach supported files; review automatic chips and remove anything not intended.
Pin required facts; compare estimated input and reserves against capacity.
Remove, compact or choose a capable model before capture.
Admission captures a versioned source manifest and the capacity calculation.
forbidden_fake_states: A filename or tab title shown as attached content
a composed context number labelled measured
silent omission of a failed attachment
complete_when: the admitted request has a versioned source manifest and valid capacity calculation (p.184).
traceability: p.184; controls C-01..C-14; acceptance A11, A12, A13, A14.
